subject: Security readout — audit logs, DPA gaps & pen-test onboarding
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Carla Ruiz <carla@aurastack.io>, David Chen <dchen@aurastack.io>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Security readout — audit logs, DPA gaps & pen-test onboarding

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call so everyone is aligned.

Key pain points you shared:
- Audit/log visibility: you need sub-second traceability for admin actions and a compact export for your SIEM (Splunk).
- Retention & e-discovery: 13–24 month retention requirements for logs tied to compliance with your internal policy.
- DPA items: need clearer dataflow mapping and an updated DPA annex that covers our audit-log retention.
- Pen test: you want a vendor-initiated pen-test window and a list of contact/SOC contacts for triage.

Goals we agreed on:
1) Provide a sample audit-log export and schema for ingestion by your security team.
2) Deliver a SOC 2 scope summary + suggested retention policy aligned with your 18-month requirement.
3) Share draft DPA annex language for retention and breach notification timelines.
4) Propose a pen-test cadence and a Redwood contact list for vulnerability coordination.

Ownership & timeline (proposed) — please flag if you want to change owners:
- Redwood to share: sample audit logs (redwood-audit-log-sample.txt), SOC 2 scope summary, and draft DPA annex — owner: Logan — ETA: 2 business days (Dec 16).
- AuroraStack to share: their DDQ + any specific log fields they require — owner: Carla — ETA: Dec 17.
- Joint: schedule a 30-min technical handoff to map log fields and ingestion options — target: week of Dec 20.

Immediate asks for this week:
- Carla: please attach the AuroraStack DDQ and any internal retention policy excerpts.
- David: confirm whether Splunk HEC or S3 push is preferred for ingest.

Attachments: aurastack_soc2_questions.xlsx (initial mapping I jotted down), redwood-audit-log-sample.txt (sanitized sample).

If that looks right I’ll circulate a short action tracker and calendar invite for the handoff.

Thanks,
Logan
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0182
From: Carla Ruiz <carla@aurastack.io>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, David Chen <dchen@aurastack.io>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 13:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security readout — audit logs, DPA gaps & pen-test onboarding

Thanks Logan — this is super helpful. Quick clarifications from our side: 
- Retention: we typically mandate 18 months for audit logs (can stretch to 24 for certain legal holds).
- Ingest: Splunk HEC is preferred, but we can receive S3 pushes if we set up a secure bucket and lifecycle.
- DPA: the main ask is explicit naming of log retention and our right to audit — we’ll need a short annex.

I attached our completed DDQ (Aurastack-Security-DDQ.pdf) and a short excerpt from our retention policy. Two additional asks: 
1) KMS: do you support customer-managed keys for logs at rest?
2) SLA: we’ll need to see a 99.9% availability commitment for the route that sends audit exports.

We’re fine with the target dates — Dec 16 for your artifacts works. I’ll confirm Splunk vs S3 by EOD Thursday (Dec 17).

Best,
Carla Ruiz
Head of Security Operations
Aurastack
carla@aurastack.io | +1 206 555 0124

Attachments referenced: Aurastack-Security-DDQ.pdf

Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Security readout — audit logs, DPA gaps & pen-test onboarding

Looping Priyom in to own the evidence intake and retention mapping.

Priyom — see Carla’s DDQ (attached in thread). Short asks for you:
- Review their DDQ and call out any missing artifacts we can provide from our current SOC 2 kit.
- Confirm whether we can support CMKs for audit-log buckets (I think keys are supported via our KMS integration, but please confirm with infra).
- Draft a short DPA annex snippet on retention and audit rights for Logan to push to Carla.

Thanks — quick reply with owners/times and I’ll add to the action tracker.

Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
